crewNotes.text: IMPORTANT: alcohol is prohibited in Pakistan - do not carry any in baggage. Compiled from the cited FBR baggage rules, pending final authority review.

rules.text: Incoming passengers carrying foreign currency exceeding USD 10,000 (or equivalent) must declare it to Pakistan Customs (Pass Track declaration). Pakistani rupees may be taken out only up to PKR 10,000.

prohibitedItems.text: Import of alcoholic beverages into Pakistan is strictly prohibited for residents and non-residents alike; do not carry any alcohol.

rules.text: Allowance for residents aged 18 or over is 200 cigarettes, or 50 cigars, or 0.5 kg of tobacco (halved on a second visit in a calendar year, not admissible on the third).

disclaimer: Verify current requirements with the relevant authority and airline procedures before travel.
